summary: AixCrypto Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a note purchase agreement with CABG Acquisition Corp., selling rights to a secured note from Marizyme (outstanding ~$4.77M plus 18% interest), a co-development note, security agreement, and related assets. Total consideration includes $100,000 cash, 10% royalty on net revenue above $20M, and a commitment by buyer to acquire/commercialize Marizyme assets. No board recommendation, advisor, or timeline given. The filing reflects a partial asset sale/assignment; watch for regulatory or Marizyme-related developments.
